title: Studio product photography
description: Polished product visuals with controlled lighting, clean backgrounds and premium composition.
prompt: Create a premium commercial product photograph. Preserve the product's exact shape, proportions, material, colours, labels and design. Use a clean studio background, soft controlled lighting, realistic shadows and a refined composition. Do not add distracting objects or alter the product.

title: Cinematic portrait lighting
description: Expressive lighting, natural skin texture and editorial framing for portrait concepts.
prompt: Create an editorial portrait with natural skin texture, realistic facial detail, expressive cinematic lighting, balanced contrast and a thoughtfully composed background.

title: Modern fashion editorial
description: Fashion campaign concepts with styling direction, pose ideas and magazine-inspired framing.
prompt: Create a premium fashion editorial image with confident natural posing, detailed fabric texture, intentional styling, sophisticated lighting and magazine-quality composition.

title: Elegant wedding invitation
description: Elegant invitation concepts with thoughtful typography, layout and colour direction.
prompt: Design an elegant Indian wedding invitation layout with refined typography, balanced spacing, premium paper texture and a harmonious colour palette. Keep all supplied names, dates and venue details exact.

title: Social media campaign creative
description: A consistent visual direction for social campaigns, posts and digital promotions.
prompt: Create a scroll-stopping social media campaign visual with a clear focal point, strong visual hierarchy, clean composition and a consistent brand-friendly colour palette.
